paper.title_en: Observationanal and Thermodynamic Analysis of Power Law form of $f (Q)$ gravity
paper.abstract_en: In this study, the power law form of f(Q) gravity $(f(Q)=Q+mQ^n)$ has been studied in view of statistical analysis with current observed data and irreversible thermodynamics. The best fit values of model specific parameters are found with the use of of 31point Hubble data, Patntheon type Supernva and 1721 point SH0ES data and a comparative study has been performed between $f(Q)$ and standard $Λ$CDM model. The thermodynamic consequence using standard Eckart theory of non-equilibrium thermodynamics has been examined independently for general form of $f(Q)$ gravity followed by power law form of $f(Q)$ where the horizon entropy is calculated using unified law of thermodynamics. Suitable range of power law model specific parameters has been explored through investigating validity of generalized second law of thermodynamics and thermodynamic equilibrium. Finally evolution nature of cosmographic parameters are studied within the specific range of $m,n$ which is compatible with the results obtained from both statistical and thermodynamical analysis.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了$f(Q)$引力的幂律形式，并利用观测数据进行了统计分析和不可逆热力学分析，与黑洞热力学和广义第二定律相关，具有一定的理论深度和方法论严谨性，因此建议进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: $f(Q)$引力幂律形式的观测与热力学分析
decision.abstract_zh: 在本研究中，基于当前观测数据和不可逆热力学，对$f(Q)$引力的幂律形式（$f(Q)=Q+mQ^n$）进行了统计分析。利用31点哈勃数据、Pantheon型超新星和1721点SH0ES数据，找到了模型特定参数的最佳拟合值，并对$f(Q)$模型与标准$\Lambda$CDM模型进行了比较研究。使用非平衡热力学的标准Eckart理论，首先针对一般形式的$f(Q)$引力，然后针对幂律形式的$f(Q)$，独立检验了热力学推论，其中视界熵通过统一热力学定律计算。通过研究广义第二定律和热力学平衡的有效性，探索了幂律模型特定参数的合适范围。最后，在$m,n$的特定范围内研究了宇宙学参数演化性质，该范围与统计和热力学分析所得结果一致。
